alerts.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 19 at 1:23AM PDT until October 20 at 9:00AM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and breaking waves. Surf of 3 to 6
feet with local sets to 7 feet. Highest surf on south and
southwest facing beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County Coastal
Areas.

* WHEN...Through Tuesday morning.

* IMPACTS...Areas of hazardous swimming conditions. Rip currents
can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can wash people
off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats nearshore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minor beach erosion may occur across
south-facing beaches.
